remaining_requirements.detail: Pinned NumPy/pandas/PyArrow/SciPy/matplotlib/tqdm/PyTorch/PyG packages remain installation dependencies, not research-checkout code.

Converter imports optional PyROOT and uses the input files' ROOT event interfaces. It does not execute G4Pioneer or load a script/library from a research path. ROOT conversion and compatibility of custom event interfaces were not exercised; simulation generation is upstream of this handoff.
Full production event pools, prediction tables and some large analysis caches remain external explicit inputs.

The complete directory, including local checkpoints/configs/examples/references/assets, is the handoff. A normal wheel generated by the current pyproject.toml is not a complete release because these non-code files are not wheel resources. Editable installation retains the complete directory layout.
